answer: Correlated slashing makes a sybil swarm pay for moving together. Each agent bonds 50 points; failing a graded audit costs 1% of the bond, multiplied by how many agents fed from the same copper funding source failed that epoch, capped at 100%. A lone agent that slips loses 1%; 30 linked fakes failing together each lose 30%, so losses spiral roughly with the square of swarm size. Weakness: one outage across a whole orchard of honest agents could punish them together unless outages are excluded.
